description: This file defines models and functions for CRM profiling and segmentation in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including questions, answers, questionnaires, and segmentation rules.

classes.name: partner
classes.description: Extension of res.partner with profiling answers and categories

classes.name: crm_segmentation
classes.description: Extension of crm.segmentation with profiling rules and hierarchy

methods.name: _get_answers
methods.description: Retrieves yes and no answers for given profile IDs

methods.name: test_prof
methods.description: Tests if a partner matches a segmentation rule based on answers

methods.name: _recompute_categ
methods.description: Recomputes partner categories based on answers and segmentation rules

methods.name: build_form
methods.description: Builds XML form for a questionnaire

methods.name: _questionnaire_compute
methods.description: Computes and updates partner answers and categories

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write method to update categories based on answers

methods.name: process_continue
methods.description: Processes segmentation rules and applies them to partners
